svg.title: Custom keyboard bindings
svg.desc: Compact keyboard with left Command, right Command, Option and held-semicolon layers, plus Neru, app launchers and AeroSpace modes.
svg.text: Custom global remaps · ABC symbols / Russian legends · app-specific overrides omitted
Hold ; + H J K L to focus; add Shift to move. ; + A floats, centers and enters window mode.
Clip shot = selection to clipboard. Capture UI = screenshot controls. Tab shortcuts exclude Neovide. ⌃ = Ctrl · ⌥ = Opt · ⇧ = Shift
F click hints P right-click hints
L Cmd + G opens a new Neovide window.
H / L width − / + J / K height + / −
Q W E R T Y U I O → workspaces 1–9
; + Q … O → send window to workspace 1–9
Arrow keys → join with neighbor, then exit
M → move workspace to next monitor
Workspace switches also exit resize mode.
H J K L → move floating window
Shift + R → reload config and exit
Sources: Karabiner / Goku · AeroSpace · Neru | Diagram shows the compact layout; firmware layers are separate.
